component.name: OnionDesk
component.summary: Free Tor VPN alternative: pick your exit country

description.p: OnionDesk is a free and open-source Tor client with a modern interface. It starts a bundled Tor client with a strict exit relay in the country you pick, shows your real and exit locations on a live world map, and ranks countries by live speed estimates. No account, no subscription, no telemetry.

ul.li: Choose a country exit, or turn on Auto to always use the fastest location
Switch location without ever exposing your real IP address
Live world map with animated pins for your real and exit IP
Optional system-wide mode that sends all TCP and DNS traffic from every app through Tor (asks for administrator permission once)
Crash-safe: your normal network settings are always restored, even if the app is killed
Tor is bundled, so there is nothing else to install

description.p: By default it is a local SOCKS5 proxy, so only apps that honour the system proxy are covered. Tor is slower than a commercial VPN and cannot carry UDP traffic. OnionDesk is not affiliated with the Tor Project.
See the release notes on GitHub for what changed.
